# Phonak

> Phonak is a leading hearing aid manufacturer offering AI-powered hearing solutions, educational resources on hearing health, and community support for individuals with hearing loss and their families.

Phonak provides comprehensive hearing care solutions including the Infinio Ultra AI-powered hearing aids, educational content on hearing health and well-being, provider directories, and inspirational stories from patients and ambassadors. The site serves as both a product showcase and a resource hub for hearing loss education and support.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered hearing aids
- Hearing health
- Hearing loss
- Bluetooth connectivity
- Audiologist selection
- Family support
- Hearing solutions
- Patient testimonials
- Workplace accommodations
- Pediatric hearing loss
- Tinnitus management
- Hearing aids adjustment
- Self-advocacy
- Well-being
- Assistive technology

## Hearing Products & Solutions

- [Infinio Ultra AI-powered, Bluetooth hearing aids | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us): Phonak homepage showcasing Infinio Ultra AI-powered hearing aids
- [Meet our Ambassadors](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/meet-our-ambassadors): Profiles of Phonak brand ambassadors and hearing empowerment champions

## Hearing Health Education

- [Well-Hearing is Well-Being | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/well-hearing): Hub for hearing health education covering well-being and hearing loss
- [Why Hearing Health Matters | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/well-hearing/hearing-health): Educational guide on importance of hearing health and overall wellness
- [Living With Hearing Loss | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/well-hearing/hearing-loss): Comprehensive guide on managing and living with hearing loss
- [Life With Hearing Aids | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/well-hearing/hearing-loss/life-with-hearing-aids): Getting started guide for adjusting to and using hearing aids
- [Hearing loss and Tinnitus](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/well-hearing/hearing-loss/tinnitus): Educational resource on tinnitus causes, symptoms, and solutions

## Getting Started with Hearing Care

- [Free Online Hearing Test | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/online-hearing-test): Free three-minute online hearing screening and assessment tool
- [Find a Hearing Care Specialist | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/find-a-provider): Provider directory to locate hearing care specialists and audiologists
- [Choosing the Best Audiologist for You | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/well-hearing/hearing-loss/choosing-audiologist): Guide to selecting the right audiologist for hearing care needs

## Family & Loved Ones Support

- [Help Loved Ones With Hearing Loss | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/well-hearing/loved-ones-with-hearing-loss): Resource hub for family members supporting loved ones with hearing loss
- [How to Tell Someone They Need Hearing Aids | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/well-hearing/loved-ones-with-hearing-loss/encourage-treatment): Guide for encouraging loved ones to seek hearing loss treatment
- [Hearing Loss in Children: Diagnosis and Support Options | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/well-hearing/loved-ones-with-hearing-loss/hearing-loss-children): Guide to pediatric hearing loss diagnosis and support options

## Life with Hearing Loss

- [Hearing Loss Accommodations at School and Work | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/well-hearing/hearing-loss/success-at-work-and-school): Guide to workplace and school accommodations for hearing loss

## Hearing Stories & Testimonials

- [Hearing Stories - Voices of Hearing Loss Individuals | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/hearing-stories): Collection of personal hearing loss stories and patient testimonials
- [Hearing Featured Stories | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/hearing-stories/feature-stories): Featured hearing loss stories highlighting patient journeys and solutions
- [Hearing Health Stories | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/hearing-stories/hearing-solutions): Customer stories showcasing hearing solutions and AI-powered hearing aids
- [Kids & Teens Hearing Stories | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/hearing-stories/kids-and-teens): Inspirational stories from children and teens with hearing loss

## Optional

- [Family & Friends Hearing Stories | Phonak](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/hearing-stories/family-and-friends): Stories from family members and friends supporting hearing loss journey
- [Hear My Life Relay](https://www.phonak.com/en-us/meet-our-ambassadors/hear-my-life-relay): Ambassador program and community relay for hearing loss awareness
